create_Items_wrapper: create an Items object wrapping an iterable of values for batch execution in the exca pipeline
create_StepItems_with_source: create a StepItems object with a dict source and optional uids for pipeline computation
apply_step_to_StepItems: apply a step to a StepItems object to append computation and identity to the pipeline
select_uids_from_StepItems: select a subset of uids from a StepItems object to narrow the pipeline input
iterate_StepItems_results: iterate over a StepItems object to execute pending steps and yield batch results
